3f4134.surface: workflow api_call action node (action-executor.ts executeApiCall + workflow-orchestrator.ts executeActionNode)
3f4134.evidence: vuln-0001; local loopback PoC confirmed redirect-following full-response SSRF; no validation between route input and fetch sink.

df513e.evidence: No auth, no verifyRequest; confirmed via local PoC creating chat session (vuln-0002).

bcf606.evidence: secretHash generated/stored but never compared in trigger path; no signature/timestamp/nonce (vuln-0003).

e482bf.risk_area: Missing webhook signature/secret verification + replay protection (unauthenticated workflow triggering)
e482bf.evidence: Static trace confirmed (no authenticate preHandler; triggerWebhook checks only existence/isEnabled/IP allowlist); executable PoC in tests/unit/webhook-trigger-authz.poc.test.ts passes 3/3 with real route and mocked prisma. Covered by existing report vuln-0003 (duplicate submission correctly rejected); my PoC evidence was attached to vuln-0003 via update_vulnerability_report.

9ac5d3.risk_area: Unauthenticated information disclosure of call/execution status
9ac5d3.evidence: Assessed as separate report candidate and it does not clear the bar: unauthenticated disclosure is limited to execution status/progress/error message and node timing for a random UUID (callRecordId, ~122 bits) — no restricted data content, no logs, and the parent vuln-0003 impact field already mentions this endpoint. Enumeration-infeasible and no cross-tenant object data returned, so it is folded into vuln-0003's narrative rather than filed standalone.

f041a4.risk_area: Secret generated but never used for request verification
f041a4.evidence: Repo-wide search for secretHash/secret_hash/hmac/signature/x-webhook confirms the stored hash is only set at creation and mapped into WebhookConfig — never compared on any trigger path. Part of vuln-0003's root cause.
